// Standard-library AST extraction only. Never executes Loki or AST constructors.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"

type obj map[string]any
type source struct {
	path string
	data []byte
	fs   *token.FileSet
	file *ast.File
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func hash(b []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b)) }
func load(root, path, want string) *source {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
	must(err)
	if hash(b) != want {
		panic("changed pinned source: " + path)
	}
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, path, b, parser.ParseComments)
	must(err)
	return &source{path, b, fs, f}
}
func (s *source) code(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(s.data[s.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func (s *source) record(n ast.Node) obj {
	a, b := s.fs.Position(n.Pos()), s.fs.Position(n.End())
	return obj{"source": s.path, "original_go": s.code(n), "source_range": obj{
		"start_line": a.Line, "start_column": a.Column, "end_line": b.Line, "end_column": b.Column,
		"start_byte": a.Offset, "end_byte_exclusive": b.Offset}}
}
func (s *source) selection(name string, n ast.Node) obj {
	r := s.record(n)
	end := s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset
	if end >= len(s.data) || s.data[end] != '\n' {
		panic("selection lacks original trailing newline")
	}
	r["name"], r["original_go"], r["sha256"] = name, s.code(n)+"\n", hash([]byte(s.code(n)+"\n"))
	return r
}
func (s *source) function(name string) *ast.FuncDecl {
	for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
		if f, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && f.Name.Name == name {
			return f
		}
	}
	panic("missing function: " + name)
}

// Only literal strings or + trees of literal strings. No identifier resolution,
// calls, formatting, query parsing, or runtime constructors are evaluated.
func literal(e ast.Expr) string {
	switch x := e.(type) {
	case *ast.BasicLit:
		if x.Kind == token.STRING {
			v, err := strconv.Unquote(x.Value)
			must(err)
			return v
		}
	case *ast.BinaryExpr:
		if x.Op == token.ADD {
			return literal(x.X) + literal(x.Y)
		}
	}
	panic("unsupported nonliteral string expression")
}
func b64(s string) string { return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(s)) }
func (s *source) calls(n ast.Node) []obj {
	out := []obj{}
	ast.Inspect(n, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
			f := s.code(c.Fun)
			if strings.HasPrefix(f, "require.") || strings.HasPrefix(f, "assert.") || f == "AssertExpressions" || f == "t.Fatalf" || f == "t.Skipf" {
				out = append(out, s.record(c))
			}
		}
		return true
	})
	return out
}
func (s *source) row(name, op string, i int, n ast.Node, query, expected ast.Expr) obj {
	r := s.record(n)
	r["table"], r["source_index"], r["operation"] = name, i, op
	r["query_bytes_base64"], r["expected_bytes_base64"] = nil, nil
	r["query_expression"], r["expected_expression"] = nil, nil
	r["provenance"] = s.record(n)
	r["query_is_direct_input"], r["expected_is_same_expression"] = query != nil, query != nil
	if query != nil {
		r["query_expression"], r["query_bytes_base64"] = s.code(query), b64(literal(query))
	}
	if expected != nil {
		r["expected_expression"], r["expected_bytes_base64"] = s.code(expected), b64(literal(expected))
	}
	return r
}
func fields(s *source, c *ast.CompositeLit, positional []string) map[string]ast.Expr {
	out := map[string]ast.Expr{}
	for i, e := range c.Elts {
		if kv, ok := e.(*ast.KeyValueExpr); ok {
			out[s.code(kv.Key)] = kv.Value
		} else {
			if i >= len(positional) {
				panic("unsupported positional field")
			}
			out[positional[i]] = e
		}
	}
	return out
}
func (s *source) table(name, op string) obj {
	f := s.function(name)
	return obj{"name": name, "operation": op, "selection": s.selection(name, f), "assertion_calls": s.calls(f), "rows": []obj{}}
}
func finish(t obj, rows []obj) obj { t["rows"], t["row_count"] = rows, len(rows); return t }

// Find the one original top-level []struct, []string or map table. Do not
// descend into it, where nested constructor literals may occur.
func tableLiteral(f *ast.FuncDecl) *ast.CompositeLit {
	var found *ast.CompositeLit
	ast.Inspect(f.Body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		c, ok := n.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		if !ok {
			return true
		}
		switch c.Type.(type) {
		case *ast.ArrayType, *ast.MapType:
			if found != nil {
				panic("multiple top-level tables")
			}
			found = c
			return false
		}
		return true
	})
	if found == nil {
		panic("missing table")
	}
	return found
}
func extractTable(s *source, name, op string) obj {
	t := s.table(name, op)
	c := tableLiteral(s.function(name))
	t["table_source"] = s.record(c)
	rows := []obj{}
	for i, e := range c.Elts {
		var q, expected ast.Expr
		var rowName string
		var m map[string]ast.Expr
		value := e
		if kv, ok := e.(*ast.KeyValueExpr); ok {
			rowName = literal(kv.Key)
			value = kv.Value
		}
		if r, ok := value.(*ast.CompositeLit); ok {
			pos := []string{}
			if name == "Test_logSelectorExpr_String" {
				pos = []string{"selector", "expectFilter"}
			}
			if name == "Test_parserExpr_String" {
				pos = []string{"name", "op", "param", "want"}
			}
			m = fields(s, r, pos)
			for _, key := range []string{"in", "query", "selector"} {
				if v := m[key]; v != nil {
					if q != nil {
						panic("multiple inputs")
					}
					q = v
				}
			}
			for _, key := range []string{"exp", "want", "out"} {
				if v := m[key]; v != nil {
					if expected != nil {
						panic("multiple expected strings")
					}
					expected = v
				}
			}
			if v := m["name"]; v != nil {
				rowName = literal(v)
			}
		} else {
			q = value
		}
		if q == nil && name != "Test_parserExpr_String" {
			panic("missing literal query")
		}
		r := s.row(name, op, i, e, q, expected)
		r["name"] = rowName
		if len(m) > 0 {
			f := obj{}
			for k, v := range m {
				f[k] = s.record(v)
			}
			r["fields"] = f
		}
		switch name {
		case "Test_logSelectorExpr_String":
			r["expected_reference"] = "tt.selector" // Original assertion, not a new literal oracle.
		case "Test_SampleExpr_String":
			r["contract"] = "ParseExpr(tc); ParseExpr(expr.String()); AssertExpressions(t, expr, expr2)"
		case "Test_SampleExpr_String_Fail":
			var oracle ast.Expr
			ast.Inspect(s.function(name), func(n ast.Node) bool {
				if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok && s.code(c.Fun) == "require.ErrorContains" {
					if oracle != nil || len(c.Args) != 3 {
						panic("changed error assertion")
					}
					oracle = c.Args[2]
				}
				return true
			})
			if oracle == nil {
				panic("missing explicit error assertion")
			}
			r["reject"], r["error_oracle"], r["expected_error_contains"] = true, "substring", literal(oracle)
			r["error_provenance"], r["expected_is_same_expression"] = s.record(oracle), false
		case "Test_parserExpr_String":
			r["contract"] = "LineParserExpr{Op: tt.op, Param: tt.param}.String(); symbolic constructor, not a query input"
		case "Test_formatQueryHandlerResponse":
			resp := m["expected"].(*ast.CompositeLit)
			fm := fields(s, resp, nil)
			response := obj{}
			for k, v := range fm {
				response[k] = obj{"value": literal(v), "provenance": s.record(v)}
			}
			r["expected_response"] = response
			if v := fm["Data"]; v != nil {
				r["expected_bytes_base64"], r["expected_expression"] = b64(literal(v)), s.code(v)
			} else {
				r["expected_is_same_expression"] = false
			}
			r["contract"] = "GET query parameter; Decode FormatQueryResponse; assert.Equal(tc.expected, got). No HTTP status assertion. Omitted response fields remain omitted source fields."
		}
		if strings.Contains(name, "CountDistinctSketch") {
			r["transformation"] = "NewCountDistinctSketchFromLabelAggregation(labelAgg) before String/Prettify; not direct formatting of input"
			r["expected_is_same_expression"] = false
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "TestFormat") {
			if v := m["maxChars"]; v != nil {
				n, err := strconv.Atoi(s.code(v))
				must(err)
				r["max_chars_per_line"] = n
			} else {
				a := s.function(name).Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt)
				if s.code(a.Lhs[0]) != "MaxCharsPerLine" {
					panic("missing formatter width assignment")
				}
				n, err := strconv.Atoi(s.code(a.Rhs[0]))
				must(err)
				r["max_chars_per_line"], r["width_provenance"] = n, s.record(a)
			}
		}
		if s.path == "pkg/logql/syntax/serialize_test.go" {
			r["contract"] = "Internal Loki AST EncodeJSON/DecodeJSON; compare Pretty(0), not HTTP/OTLP/Pulse wire JSON; no literal serialization or output oracle"
		}
		rows = append(rows, r)
	}
	return finish(t, rows)
}
func parserSingles(s *source) []obj {
	name := "TestNoOpLabelToString"
	f := s.function(name)
	t := s.table(name, "string")
	q := f.Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt).Rhs[0]
	eq := f.Body.List[3].(*ast.ExprStmt).X.(*ast.CallExpr)
	if s.code(eq.Fun) != "require.Equal" || len(eq.Args) != 3 {
		panic("changed no-op assertion")
	}
	r := s.row(name, "string", 0, f.Body, q, eq.Args[1])
	r["contract"] = "ParseLogSelector(logExpr, false); exact String equality; optimized stages length zero; preserve all assertions"
	t = finish(t, []obj{r})
	name = "TestParseSampleExpr_String"
	f = s.function(name)
	u := s.table(name, "string")
	rows := []obj{}
	for i, stmt := range f.Body.List {
		call := stmt.(*ast.ExprStmt).X.(*ast.CallExpr)
		if s.code(call.Fun) != "t.Run" {
			panic("expected direct subtest")
		}
		body := call.Args[1].(*ast.FuncLit).Body
		q := body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt).Rhs[0]
		var expect ast.Expr
		ast.Inspect(body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
			if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok && s.code(c.Fun) == "require.Equal" {
				if id, ok := c.Args[1].(*ast.Ident); ok {
					if id.Name != "query" {
						panic("unexpected reference")
					}
				} else {
					expect = c.Args[1]
				}
			}
			return true
		})
		r := s.row(name, "string", i, stmt, q, expect)
		r["name"] = literal(call.Args[0])
		if expect == nil {
			r["expected_reference"] = "query"
		}
		rows = append(rows, r)
	}
	return []obj{t, finish(u, rows)}
}
func grouping(s *source) obj {
	name := "TestGroupingString"
	f := s.function(name)
	t := s.table(name, "grouping")
	rows := []obj{}
	if len(f.Body.List) != 12 {
		panic("changed grouping statement count")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 6; i++ {
		construction := f.Body.List[2*i].(*ast.AssignStmt)
		if _, ok := construction.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit); !ok {
			panic("expected grouping literal")
		}
		assertion := f.Body.List[2*i+1].(*ast.ExprStmt).X.(*ast.CallExpr)
		if s.code(assertion.Fun) != "require.Equal" {
			panic("changed grouping assertion")
		}
		r := s.row(name, "grouping", i, construction, nil, assertion.Args[1])
		r["construction"], r["assertion"] = s.record(construction), s.record(assertion)
		r["contract"] = "Symbolic Grouping constructor, not a query; literal String output"
		rows = append(rows, r)
	}
	return finish(t, rows)
}
func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	}
	paths := []string{"pkg/logql/syntax/parser_test.go", "pkg/logql/syntax/prettier_test.go", "pkg/logql/syntax/ast_test.go", "pkg/logql/syntax/serialize_test.go", "pkg/loki/format_query_handler_test.go"}
	hashes := []string{"0a8466fd5d9cab3f852f9a18a52dc54b7b1a1ab0c9c6af53ca1df21d9f38ce99", "f4ebfe9075503a491febd1ca60e10a983f17d8580080f1c7f4ea76ba285a8527", "b058fddd8f947e159e62e694394819eb358557e040c8c27f4f69d47a16be95a6", "2a0ce1e2b8232ed4098e44c7f489f09b793f5338ae9a55a070abdf13943b8ba8", "dfb90519ca32e932462434e033754d7b77451239035c385b2d5a48499fbe5595"}
	src := []*source{}
	sources := []obj{}
	for i, p := range paths {
		s := load(os.Args[1], p, hashes[i])
		src = append(src, s)
		sources = append(sources, obj{"path": p, "sha256": hashes[i]})
	}
	tables := parserSingles(src[0])
	// Every function in prettier_test.go is in scope. Fail on future additions.
	prettyNames := []string{"TestFormat", "TestFormat_VectorAggregation", "TestFormat_LabelAggregation", "TestLabelAggregationExpr_String", "TestFormat_CountDistinctSketch", "TestCountDistinctSketchExpr_String", "TestFormat_LabelReplace", "TestFormat_BinOp"}
	n := 0
	for _, d := range src[1].file.Decls {
		if _, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok {
			n++
		}
	}
	if n != len(prettyNames) {
		panic("changed prettier function inventory")
	}
	for _, name := range prettyNames {
		op := "string"
		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "TestFormat") {
			op = "prettify"
		}
		tables = append(tables, extractTable(src[1], name, op))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"Test_logSelectorExpr_String", "Test_SampleExpr_String", "Test_SampleExpr_String_Fail", "TestStringer", "Test_parserExpr_String"} {
		op := "string"
		if name == "Test_SampleExpr_String" {
			op = "roundtrip"
		}
		if name == "Test_parserExpr_String" {
			op = "symbolic"
		}
		tables = append(tables, extractTable(src[2], name, op))
	}
	tables = append(tables, grouping(src[2]), extractTable(src[4], "Test_formatQueryHandlerResponse", "http-format"))
	serial := extractTable(src[3], "TestJSONSerializationRoundTrip", "symbolic")
	tables = append(tables, serial)
	f := src[3].function("TestJSONSerializationCountDistinctSketch")
	t := src[3].table(f.Name.Name, "symbolic")
	q := f.Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt).Rhs[0].(*ast.CallExpr).Args[0]
	r := src[3].row(f.Name.Name, "symbolic", 0, f.Body, q, nil)
	r["expected_is_same_expression"] = false
	r["contract"] = "Internal Loki AST serialization of NewCountDistinctSketchFromLabelAggregation; EncodeJSON/DecodeJSON; sketch.String() == actual.String(); no literal output or Pulse wire oracle"
	tables = append(tables, finish(t, []obj{r}))
	f = src[3].function("TestJSONSerializationParseTestCases")
	ref := src[3].table(f.Name.Name, "symbolic")
	var shared *ast.ValueSpec
	for _, d := range src[0].file.Decls {
		if g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl); ok {
			for _, v := range g.Specs {
				if v, ok := v.(*ast.ValueSpec); ok && v.Names[0].Name == "ParseTestCases" {
					shared = v
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if shared == nil {
		panic("missing shared ParseTestCases")
	}
	sharedRecord := src[0].record(shared)
	delete(sharedRecord, "original_go")
	sharedRecord["sha256"] = hash([]byte(src[0].code(shared)))
	sharedRecord["fixture"], sharedRecord["selection"] = "syntax-admission.json", "ParseTestCases"
	ref["shared_table_reference"] = sharedRecord
	ref["contract"] = "For ParseTestCases with tc.err == nil: ParseExpr(tc.in); skip strings.Contains(tc.in, KiB); internal AST EncodeJSON/DecodeJSON; AssertExpressions(t, tc.exp, actual). Reference existing syntax-admission.json, do not duplicate or reinterpret as wire JSON."
	tables = append(tables, finish(ref, []obj{}))
	count, queries, expected, rejects := 0, 0, 0, 0
	ops := map[string]int{}
	for _, t := range tables {
		for _, r := range t["rows"].([]obj) {
			count++
			ops[r["operation"].(string)]++
			if r["query_bytes_base64"] != nil {
				queries++
			}
			if r["expected_bytes_base64"] != nil {
				expected++
			}
			if r["reject"] == true {
				rejects++
			}
		}
	}
	out := obj{"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "sources": sources, "tables": tables, "row_count": count, "literal_query_count": queries, "literal_expected_count": expected, "explicit_reject_count": rejects, "operation_counts": ops, "contract": "Source fixtures only; internal AST JSON is not Pulse wire JSON. No formatting parity or runtime execution claim."}
	e := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	e.SetIndent("", "  ")
	must(e.Encode(out))
}
